about: 100-point profile score. A visitor decides to follow in a few seconds from the top of the profile. Score each item 0..max with a one-line reason. Items marked auto are checked by `igos profile`.

items.check: Profile photo: a face (personal brand) or a simple mark (business) readable at 110px. No text in the circle.
Name field includes the searchable term for what you do, not just your name.
Handle is sayable out loud and spelled the obvious way.
Bio line 1 says who you help and with what, in their words.
One proof point: a number, a client, a credential that matters to the audience.
Bio ends on one action that matches the link.
Link goes to one destination that fulfils the bio's promise and loads fast on mobile.
Three pinned posts: one origin/proof, one best teaching piece, one offer or lead magnet.
The first 9 posts deliver what the bio promises. A stranger can tell the topic without reading captions.
Covers read correctly in the 3:4 grid crop: no cut-off text, consistent cover style.
Highlights are navigation: start here, results, offer, FAQ. Named in 1-2 words. Old event highlights removed.
Professional account with the right category and a working contact or booking button.
